task: Add a save-time contract linker to CodeMie workflows: new input_schema/validation/require_input_contracts keys, graph-wide data-availability simulation with OK/ERROR/WARNING/UNVERIFIED outcomes and provenance, derived requirements, strict/warn modes and a template-corpus warning ceiling (EPMCDME-16503).

key_reasoning.reason: New analysis abstraction (linker/simulator with outcome and provenance model) under workflows/validation, plus WorkflowState/WorkflowConfig models, execution_config_schema.yaml and a hook in WorkflowExecutor.validate_workflow; it must mirror runtime rules spread over about eight modules (base_node, models reducer, workflow iteration/routing, tool_node, transform_node, dynamic_value_utils) without changing them.

No exact precedent: nearest patterns are the stage-by-stage validate_workflow, the advisory warnings list and the generator ValidationNode producer/consumer checks, none of which cover graph-wide availability simulation. Risks are rule drift against runtime, a single-exception contract that generator retry-loop callers rely on, tool parameter schemas not available at save (UNVERIFIED will dominate), lenient parsing of example-form contracts in about 56 templates, and a dependency on the unmerged bug-fix-codemie. Closest pattern has no security-sensitive aspect, so no security bump. The AC enumerate many edge and variant cases (append, keep_current, reset, iteration, parallel, cycles) with no existing table-driven test template for them, so Technical Risk was bumped to XL.

About 7-8 modified (workflow_models.py, workflow_config.py, execution_config_schema.yaml, workflow.py, validation/__init__.py, validation/models.py, openapi.json baseline, possibly templates) and 4-6 new (linker/simulator modules and several test files). Spans src/core, src/workflows/validation, config and tests.
